changelog: 0.1.14: re-merged onto clean POV 6.08.10 (four upstream releases: Easynews scraper now uses seas_ep_filter like the other cloud scrapers, AIOStreams follow-ups from issue #129, list sort order #128, a typo fix #130). Both overlaid files upstream touched (menus/movies.py, menus/tvshows.py) took a one-line ADDITIVE change -- the discover branch now accepts tmdb_media_discover alongside the old per-media action -- and merged with ZERO conflicts. Nothing of ours reads those action names (the only repo hits are in the GEARS overlay, a separate engine). Verified: 0 conflict markers, valid AST, 0 upstream lines lost, KODIRDIL markers intact, new upstream branch present. 0.1.13: re-merged onto clean POV 6.08.06 (UNDOCUMENTED upstream release, ~50 files: the Fen-era `fenom` helper package was vendored into `magneto/modules` with every import rewired -- our overlay never imports fenom, confirmed by grep; debrid menu order now driven by provider_sort_ranks(); trakt_dict id_type dropped in movies/tvshows; download-dir settings gained option=writeable; hidden database.merge_status setting removed, not referenced by our configs). All 4 overlaid files merged with ZERO conflicts; the only 'lost' upstream lines are our deliberate meta_language he/Hebrew bake. Verified: 0 conflict markers, valid AST+XML, KODIRDIL markers + 10 hebrew_subtitles settings intact, provider_sort_ranks present in merged navigator. 0.1.12: re-merged onto clean POV 6.08.05 (AIOStreams behavior change from issue #127: internal debrid cloud scrapers can now run BEFORE aiostreams when 'Check Before Full Search' is enabled -- prepare_internal grew a prescrape param and the results-collection order was reshuffled; also new calendar.include_airdate setting). Both overlaid files merged with ZERO conflicts; semantic check confirmed our patches (Hebrew-subs thread + gearsai prefetch at top of get_sources) do not touch the changed prepare_internal/active_internal_scrapers flow. Verified: 0 conflict markers, valid AST+XML, 0 upstream lines lost, 3 KODIRDIL markers + 10 hebrew_subtitles settings intact. 0.1.11: re-merged onto clean POV 6.08.03 (separate Watchlist sort for Movies vs TV Shows, MDBList Calendar sharing Settings/My Lists/Calendar, seasons+episodes support in MDBList lists). Both overlaid files that upstream touched (menus/navigator.py, settings.xml) merged with ZERO conflicts, but upstream renamed three identifiers, so the textual merge was checked semantically: mode build_my_calendar -> build_my_calendar_trakt (new build_my_calendar_mdbl alongside it), setting sort.watchlist -> sort.watchlist_movies + sort.watchlist_shows, and navigator.log_utils is now commented out upstream with its items inlined. None of those are read by our overlay code; the settings rename IS shipped in our POV configs, so the dead sort.watchlist id was replaced with both new ids in all six config-variants (same value 0 = Title, which is also upstream's default). Verified: 0 conflict markers, valid AST + XML, 0 upstream lines lost, KODIRDIL markers and all 10 hebrew_subtitles settings intact. 0.1.10: re-merged onto clean POV 6.08.01 (AIOStreams scraper, TMDB trending fallbacks, MDBList OAuth, torboxnews removed upstream -- TorBox is killing its search API; TorBox WebDL web_id fix). Conflicts resolved: upstream moved get_provider/quality_and_path earlier (dropped our duplicate copies), removed the prepare_internal() call from get_sources, and changed the UNCACHED click to add-to-cloud only (no resolve+play), so that publish_player_release call went with it -- 3 play-selection sites remain. Verified: 0 conflict markers, valid AST all files, all KODIRDIL markers + 10 hebrew_subtitles settings + publish/clear of subs.player_filename + gearsai prefetch + debrid banner preserved, 0 URLName. 0.1.9: banner waits for the home window before toasting (a notification fired before the skin is ready is silently dropped -- boot race), and every skip/failure now logs a kodirdil banner line instead of a blind except-pass. 0.1.8: banner text made bidi-safe (Hebrew-leading, single Latin run at the end) -- the mixed-run line rendered scrambled on RTL. 0.1.7: debrid subscription banner FIXED -- it never showed because the field paths were ported verbatim from Gears, but POV unwraps the data envelope in _request (TorBox+AllDebrid): data.premium_expires_at -> premium_expires_at, data.user.premiumUntil -> user.premiumUntil; the dig returned None and the silent except hid it. 0.1.6: the clear-on-open of subs.player_filename now fires only when NOTHING is playing -- browsing the source list mid-playback and backing out was wiping the ACTIVE release, flipping every subtitle match percentage to tagline-similarity (44/40/38 -> 25/25/23). 0.1.5: publish the chosen source's release name on Window(10000) as subs.player_filename (cleared when the source list opens). Gears has always set this in modules/player.py; POV never did, and for debrid streams the player's own file is a bare UUID (997ec702-0c77-...), so subtitle services had NO channel to learn which release is playing. GearsAI fell back to VideoPlayer.Tagline -- the movie's marketing tagline -- so match.player_release() returned empty and the community pool took its 'no release detected' path, which is how an out-of-sync Hebrew subtitle got served for Supergirl. Set at all four play-selection points (direct, manual magnet/nzb, seekable easynews, browse packs). 0.1.4: filter menu -- ALL kodirdil filters now sort to the TOP as one bulleted group (SDR was appended last), and the [COLOR] markup was dropped: select_dialog renders rows with line1.upper(), which uppercases the tag itself ([COLOR cyan] -> [COLOR CYAN]); Kodi cannot resolve that colour, so a label wrapped entirely in the tag rendered as an EMPTY row -- the blank "מיין לפי כתוביות עבריות" entry. 0.1.3: filter_results -- the kodirdil Hebrew-subs/SDR filter choices were handled AFTER the quality/provider fall-through, which built its options from a nonexistent tikiskins.<choice> property -> empty second dialog (0/0) and no filtering. The custom choices are now single-action branches handled first. 0.1.2: re-merged onto clean POV 6.07.89. Upstream renamed the source-result field URLName -> display_name (produced in modules/sources.py, consumed in windows/sources.py) and added a hidden database.merge_status setting. Textual 3-way merge was clean, but our kodirdil READS of that field (tried-source identifier in _add/_is_tried_source, and the Hebrew per-source tagline matcher) still pointed at URLName -> re-pointed to display_name so Hebrew matching keeps working. Verified: 0 URLName left, 0 upstream lines lost, valid AST, all KODIRDIL markers (3+9) + 10 hebrew_subtitles settings preserved. 0.1.1: re-merged onto clean POV 6.07.08. Upstream refactored modules/sources.py results/thread machinery (wait() -> thread_monitor()+progress_update(), removed random.shuffle, as_completed flow); our kodirdil Hebrew-subs thread + GearsAI prefetch trigger (top of get_sources) re-applied by 3-way merge, verified leak-free (0 upstream lines lost, valid AST). 0.1.0: initial Hebrew overlay re-derived fresh from the current Gears overlay (kodirdil) onto clean POV 6.07.07.
